# jans_link_configuration (Resource)

Resource for managing the Jans Link plugin configuration. This resource cannot be created or deleted, only imported and updated.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_person_modification` (Boolean) Whether person modification is allowed.
- `attribute_mapping` (Block List) Mapping of source to destination attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--attribute_mapping))
- `base_dn` (String) Base DN of the Link configuration.
- `clean_service_interval` (Number) Time interval for the clean up service in seconds.
- `contact_object_class_types` (List of String) Contact object class types.
- `custom_ldap_filter` (String) Custom LDAP filter applied to the source search.
- `default_inum_server` (Boolean) Whether this is the default inum server.
- `disable_external_logger_configuration` (Boolean) Whether to disable the external log4j2 configuration override.
- `disable_jdk_logger` (Boolean) Boolean value specifying whether to enable JDK Loggers.
- `external_logger_configuration` (String) Path to an external logging configuration.
- `inum_config` (Block List, Max: 1) Inum LDAP server configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--inum_config))
- `keep_external_person` (Boolean) Whether to keep externally managed persons.
- `key_attributes` (List of String) Key attributes.
- `key_object_classes` (List of String) Key object classes.
- `ldap_search_size_limit` (Number) LDAP search size limit.
- `link_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Link service is enabled.
- `logging_layout` (String) Logging layout used by the Link server.
- `logging_level` (String) Logging level for the Link server.
- `metric_reporter_enabled` (Boolean) Boolean value specifying whether to enable Metric Reporter.
- `metric_reporter_interval` (Number) The interval for metric reporter in seconds.
- `metric_reporter_keep_data_days` (Number) The days to keep report data.
- `person_custom_object_class` (String) Person custom object class.
- `person_object_class_types` (List of String) Person object class types.
- `polling_interval` (String) Interval between synchronization runs.
- `server_ip_address` (String) IP address of the server running the Link service.
- `snapshot_folder` (String) Folder where snapshots are stored.
- `snapshot_max_count` (Number) Maximum number of snapshots to keep.
- `source_attributes` (List of String) Source attributes.
- `source_configs` (Block List) Source LDAP server configurations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--source_configs))
- `supported_user_status` (List of String) Supported user status values.
- `target_config` (Block List, Max: 1) Target LDAP server configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--target_config))
- `update_method` (String) Method used to update entries.
- `use_local_cache` (Boolean) Boolean value to indicate if Local Cache is to be used.
- `use_search_limit` (Boolean) Whether to apply the LDAP search size limit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_update` (String) Timestamp of the last synchronization run.
- `last_update_count` (String) Number of entries processed in the last synchronization run.
- `problem_count` (String) Number of problems encountered in the last synchronization run.
